cases.barrier: preload before read; PING/ACK fence; trusted release
assertions: actual HTTP/2 and underlying Bandit adapter
measured read return exceeds its requested length
exact captured bytes/signature; positive success within admission deadline
cases.missing_witness: uncovered qualification; do not omit over-target assertion

cases.framing: no Content-Length; legal receive-credit pump; END_STREAM on last payload DATA frame

cases.final_write: reserve credit; send final full DATA and final one-byte END_STREAM DATA in one bounded TCP write
cases.branch_limit: early refusal at the nonterminal cap is allowed; not proof the greater-than-cap comparison consumed the extra byte

cases.layer: package read via public Plug call
assertions: incomplete read by fixed bound despite nonprogress frames
actual production capture/1 and monotonic clock

server_profile.max_requests: unchanged default; client opens exactly one request

root_selection_before_implementation: Bind actual 1.14.0 source for timeout return and prequeued batching witness; local shared dependency source remains 1.13.1. Canonical target bytes now match the accepted integration proposal. No download or runtime in this design.
validation_path: Ordinary remote Phoenix CI discovery and retained test log; no wrapper, workflow, DB or provider change.
qualification_boundaries: public wire/reader behavior for specified finite inputs only
not full upstream advisory coverage or exploit/DoS proof
